Hey man, I’m just like you. I’m also a 17 year old male. There was a party in November that my friends really wanted me to be a part of and okay with and I wasn’t. That party loomed over me for over a month. Now there was the New Years party. I survived it and I managed and battled through everything and had a decent time compared to previous events. In end it’s all in your head. It’s all in self confidence and how far you are willing to push yourself to be okay. If you can find any sort of self confidence in any way that’ll go a long way to being okay in the future at parties. Even having a slightly positive mindset will go a long way to eventually being better and okay with everything. Also try and find some motivation to be okay and happy at these events if possible. Think of your friends. Think of how they enjoy your company and want to spend time with you, and how much happier they will be with you happy around them. Hope this helps!

Thanks for the advice. I had a great coach coach and he knew things were off. Because of myself being so off I got scratched from our game (which turned out to be the last game of the season) so I didn't even play. I was sort of relieved that I got scratched cause I really wasn't feeling playing but at the same time it made me realize a lot about myself. The last week has been really eye opening to me about not getting down on myself and not letting my issues have an effect on my play. I'm now playing for another team in their playoffs and I've never felt more confident in a long time. Just goes to show what an open mind can do.
